run_evaluate_heuristic_baselines: run the heuristic baseline evaluation CLI with train, dev, devtest, and teststd files and a baseline type
create_HeuristicBaseline: create a HeuristicBaseline instance with a scene JSON folder and baseline type such as random, all_objects, or no_objects
test_random_baseline: test the random baseline that returns random -1 and 1 labels for each object in a batch
test_all_objects_baseline: test the all_objects baseline that returns all 1 labels to select every object in a batch
test_no_objects_baseline: test the no_objects baseline that returns all -1 labels to select no object in a batch
